right.name: side tabs
right.use_when: Investment thesis pillars: bold claim + evidence -> so what -> implication (35+ words per pillar)
right.dont_use_when: Short facts or one-liners (use pill_rows); a process (use chevrons)

picked.name: bullets
picked.use_when: Numbered commentary beside an exhibit: bold lead-in + evidence + so what, 2-6 points
picked.dont_use_when: The main exhibit of a page (pick a chart, table or diagram); more than 2 bullet blocks on one slide

why: 3 short text points on approval and timing are commentary beside the offer exhibit, not a visual on their own

right.name: Segment table with side tabs + commentary column

message: Management forecast shows capex shifting to Renewables with EBITDA and EPS growth to 2035

right.name: fin chart
right.use_when: One metric's trend with CAGR, actual / estimate split and a % margin strip
right.dont_use_when: Several unrelated metrics (use fin_table); two forecast cases compared (use bk11); 2-4 metrics or segments each needing its own chart (use bk36)

picked.name: 2x2 chart dashboard
picked.use_when: Historical / projected summary as 2-4 small charts, one per metric or segment (e.g. revenue, EBITDA, segment EBITDA with CAGRs), or market data in 2-4 panels

why: 12-year EPS series is one of several metrics (capex, EBITDA, EPS) in the message, so a 2x2 chart dashboard panel; fin_chart if shown alone

right.name: Landscape page: logo wall by segment beside a chart
right.use_when: Competitive landscape or buyer universe: logos grouped into 3 segments, a scale bar chart beside it

picked.name: logo row
picked.use_when: Peers, buyers, sponsors, customers or tenants as logo tiles (target highlighted)
picked.dont_use_when: Players that need numbers beside them (use a bar chart with the target navy)

why: Named credential deals by sub-sector with few numbers are tombstone tiles (precedent software deals -> logo_row)
